_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil's 97% hold-rate over 7 days makes HOLD the statistically honest call, but if forced to lean, the analyst's higher-trust factor read (ETF flows at zero, funding crowded) tilts the next-leg probability toward Anxiety rather than Hope.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both see downside risk as the next resolution, but the analyst names Anxiety specifically with defined breakers while the narrative writer implies a deeper move to Capitulation; the split is on depth and conviction, not direction.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 20 AND VIX drops below 55 within 48h — this would shift the coil toward Hope and upgrade signal to LONG.
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks $61,000 with funding > 0.015% AND stablecoin_growth drops below 40 — this confirms the analyst's pre-panic read and downgrades signal to REDUCE.
